def save(name,obj):
    with (branch/name).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        json.dump(obj,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
        handle.write('\n')
def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

review=[]
source_map={}
for item in saved['sources']:
    month=item['stat_month']
    source=item['source']
    if source['http_status']!=200 or source['raw_path'] is None:
        review.append({'stat_month':month,'title_identity':'UNKNOWN','own_publication_clock':'UNKNOWN','body_available':False})
        source_map[month]=item
        continue
    raw=(root/source['raw_path']).read_bytes()
    if sha(raw)!=source['raw_sha256']:
        raise RuntimeError('登记原件发生变化：'+month)
    soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,'html.parser')
    headings=[{'tag':n.name,'class':n.get('class'),'text':n.get_text(' ',strip=True)} for n in soup.select('h1,h2,h3,h4,h5')]
    expected='解读'+str(int(month[:4]))+'年'+str(int(month[5:]))+'月中国采购经理指数'
    identity=any(expected in re.sub(r'\s+','',n['text']) for n in headings)
    if not identity:
        raise RuntimeError('固定原件题名未核实：'+month)
    r={'stat_month':month,'source':source,'title_identity':True,'actual_headings':headings,'own_publication_clock':item['own_publication_clock'],'first_vintage_authenticated':False,'body_available':item['manufacturing_section']!='UNKNOWN_MANUFACTURING_SECTION'}
    review.append(r)
    source_map[month]=item
